lead.event: BEI announces HSC-stock exclusion and shareholder-affiliation disclosure reforms
lead.headline: BEI plans to exclude 80 HSC stocks from IHSG and expand ownership disclosures
lead.blurb: The 80 High Shareholding Concentration stocks will remain listed and tradable, but their price movements will no longer affect IHSG. They carry an estimated combined index weight of 18.41%. BEI will also disclose whether shareholders with 1% or more are affiliates or non-affiliates. President director Jeffrey Hendrik said effective dates for both changes would be announced later.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Indonesian issuers announce share buybacks amid market volatility
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: UNTR and other issuers announce buybacks of up to Rp2 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Barito Renewables, Chandra Asri Pacific, Barito Pacific and Dian Swastatika Sentosa each plan up to Rp1 trillion, while Petrindo Jaya Kreasi, KLBF and TOWR each plan up to Rp500 billion. BREN, BRPT and CUAN’s buyback periods run through 31 December, and DSSA’s through 18 January 2027.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Bank Mandiri and BNI strengthen capital through AT1 issuances
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BMRI and BBNI strengthen capital with US$750m and US$700m AT1 issues
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bank Mandiri issued a US$750 million perpetual bond in late September, recognized as additional core capital. BNI completed a US$700 million AT1 issuance in April at a 7.15% annual yield, counted as additional core capital by end-May, and plans to repurchase most of its 2021 AT1 instruments.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Telkom prepares to accelerate its Rp4 trillion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: TLKM prepares to accelerate its share buyback of up to Rp4 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: More than Rp3 trillion of the allocation remained as of 19 October, with Telkom funding purchases from internal cash and weighing market conditions, cash position and operational and investment needs. Approved on 8 June, the program runs through 8 June 2027.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: ADRO and AADI begin share buybacks
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: ADRO and AADI begin buybacks capped at Rp10 trillion combined
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Alamtri Resources and Adaro Andalan each allocated up to Rp5 trillion for repurchases. ADRO’s 12-month implementation period began 18 April, while AADI’s buyback runs until 22 May 2027.

market_structure_policy.event: OJK imposes Rp2.1 trillion in capital-market fines on DSSA, BREN, and CUAN-related parties
market_structure_policy.headline: OJK imposes Rp2.1 trillion in fines on DSSA, BREN and CUAN-related parties
market_structure_policy.blurb: The penalties comprise Rp1.5 trillion for DSSA, Rp500 billion for BREN and Rp100 billion related to CUAN’s public offering. OJK alleged share-trading manipulation at DSSA and planned allocations to controlling-shareholder-related parties in the BREN and CUAN offerings. CUAN said it was not directly fined and expected no material impact.

earnings_guidance.event: SSIA reports a return to profit in the first half of 2026
earnings_guidance.headline: SSIA returns to profit in first half of 2026 with Rp262.6 billion net income
earnings_guidance.blurb: Surya Semesta Internusa's revenue rose 58.4%, while management targets full-year revenue of Rp7.2 trillion and net profit of around Rp400 billion. Marketing sales reached 24.1 hectares against a 135-hectare annual target, and the hotel segment remained in net loss.

earnings_guidance.event: BRIS reports Rp139 trillion in remittance transactions through September
earnings_guidance.headline: BRIS reports Rp139 trillion in remittance transactions through September
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Syariah Indonesia said integration with its e-channels lifted remittance service users by 15%, supported by 15 remittance partners and 29 global partners. Corporate Secretary Wisnu Sunandar said the bank is optimistic remittance business growth this year will exceed last year's.

deals_control.event: ISB transfers its 26.667% WIFI stake to Sinergi Graha Kapital
deals_control.headline: ISB transfers 26.667% WIFI stake to SGK for Rp4.06 trillion
deals_control.blurb: Solusi Sinergi Digital’s controlling shareholder, Investasi Sukses Bersama, sold 1.416 billion shares at Rp2,870 each on 19 October to Sinergi Graha Kapital, which had held no shares. ISB’s holding fell to 27.756%, but it remains the largest shareholder and controller, with no change of control. An extraordinary general meeting on 21 October will consider the resignations of the president commissioner and a director.

macro_flows.event: MSCI consults on Indonesia’s market classification, prompting market reactions
macro_flows.headline: MSCI consults on Indonesia reclassification, with US$5.6 billion in potential outflows
macro_flows.blurb: The consultation runs through 30 April 2027, with a final decision due by 30 June. During that period, MSCI will freeze several changes to Indonesian stock indexes and continue removing stocks identified by Indonesian authorities under its high-shareholding-concentration framework.
